messages:
nora (atlas): Hey team — running a week-long POC and hit a 1.2B token spike in integration tests overnight. Their finance capped the pilot budget; can we do a temporary per-token adjustment or grant credits so the pilot doesn't die?
Emma (sales): Thanks for the heads up. Quick Qs: is the spike one-time or repeating across tests? do they have any chance to sign a commit if pilot looks good?
Nora (atlas): Mostly one-off stress tests but they'll do more iter iterations next 2 weeks. They said if perf/latency holds they'll convert. No commit yet.
Mike (revops): We can do either: 1) apply a one-time ad-hoc credit or 2) create a time-limited rate tier on their API key. Need numbers — what dollar exposure are they expecting?
Nora (atlas): They estimated ~$260k at current rates for the spike window. Pilot budget is $40k.
Sanjay (solutions): Technically we can attach an override rate to the API key for a bounded period (no code deploy). Example rule: ```{"override_rate_per_1M_tokens_cents":400, "start":"2026-03-01", "end":"2026-03-31", "cap_usd":200000}``` That would cap their outlay.
Dave (acct exec): Preferable to do a temporary tier + explicit dollar cap and auto-revert. Keeps billing predictable.
Emma (sales): My proposal: $200k promotional credit + auto-revert to normal rates after 30 days. Ask: revops/deal-desk signoff, legal OK? We can make conversion incentives.
Priya (legal): Fine with a one-time promotional credit but include language: "one-time courtesy; not precedent for future pricing; limited to pilot window; subject to audit for abuse." Also need to record signoff owner.
Ana (deal-desk): For $200k credit we need ACV signal or exec sponsor. If no commit, deal desk requires C-level approval. We can approve up to $50k without exec.
Nora (atlas): They can probably do a short-term letter of intent for conversion if pilot hits SLA. Would that help?
Emma (sales): Yes — if they provide LOI pointing to a 12-month commit on success we can escalate to approve full $200k. Otherwise we fallback to $50k ad-hoc credit + temporary tier to soften spikes.
Mike (revops): Action items: (1) sales to upload LOI + expected monthly tokens if convert; (2) revops to draft billing rule and cap; (3) legal to prepare promo language; (4) deal-desk to confirm approval path. I'll queue the billing override once LOI or exec approval is in.
Sanjay (solutions): Also note: we can implement a soft-throttle at 95% of cap to avoid extremely high latency or runaway cost — notify customer before hitting throttle.
Emma (sales): Great. Nora — can you get a LOI or exec note today/tomorrow? I'll start paperwork.
Nora (atlas): I'll ping their CFO now. Thanks.
billing-bot: Invoice note prepared: `promo_credit_usd=200000 | conditional_on=LOI_or_exec_approval | auto_revert=2026-03-31`. Please confirm before we enable. :memo:
Ana (deal-desk): If LOI comes in, tag me and I'll run the final approval. If not, we can sign $50k credit and set override rate as discussed. :thumbsup:
Emma (sales): Sounds good. I'll update this thread when I have the LOI or CFO note.
